info.name: PayPal Commerce Agent — AI Café
info.description:
Complete API collection for **AI Café**, an agentic-commerce prototype built for the PayPal AI Hackathon.

The agent prepares a shopping cart from natural-language intent, but the **server owns all prices** and a **human authorizes every PayPal payment**. The AI never touches money. A read-only PayPal **Ops Copilot** lets a merchant audit activity.

**How to use**
1. Import this collection and the `paypal-commerce-agent.postman_environment.json` file.
2. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:3000`) — or your Render URL.
3. Run folder **`0 · Authentication > Start session`** first. It mints a server-side session and stores `sessionId` + `sessionToken` for the rest of the run (collection-level Bearer auth uses them automatically).
4. Then run any request, folder, or the whole collection in the Collection Runner.

**Why some requests return 503**: `AI chat`, `Orders create`, and `Ops ask` require server-side secrets (an AI key, PayPal sandbox credentials, or the Ops key). On a fresh deploy without those, the API answers `503` by design — the collection's tests accept `200/201` *or* `503` so the run stays green. Set the secrets in your environment (or Render dashboard) to exercise the full flow.

Prize context: this collection is the tryability surface for the **Postman** sponsor prize.

item.name: 4 · Policy (human-in-the-loop)
item.description: The server is the sole authority on price + policy. These endpoints preview or enforce per-purchase, daily-spend, confirmation, and blocked-attribute rules. Defaults: per-purchase ≤ €20, daily ≤ €100, confirmation ≥ €10, blocked dietary = alcohol.

request.description: 930 minor = €9.30 → under the €10 confirmation threshold → AUTO_ALLOW. Side-effect free advisory UX.
1650 minor = €16.50 → above the €10 threshold → REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION (human must approve the payment).
9000 minor = €90.00 → above the €20 per-purchase limit → BLOCK (never reaches PayPal).
